EstimationSolutionTiming.description: What one solution measured during the estimation of a limits profile.

language.description: The language it was timed as, which decides its group.
language.title: Language

role.description:
Which side of the limit it bounds: `lower` for an accepted
solution, `upper` for one expected to be too slow.

time.description:
Its running time, in milliseconds, when it finished. Absent
for a slow solution that never finished, or was never run.
time.title: Time

survivedAt.description:
For a slow solution that never finished: the highest limit,
in milliseconds, it was seen still running at. Absent when it finished, or was
never run.
survivedAt.title: Survivedat

EstimationSolutionTiming.title: EstimationSolutionTiming

time.description: Value to override time limit with, in milliseconds.
time.title: Time

memory.description: Value to override memory limit with, in MB.
memory.title: Memory

value.description:
The bound, in milliseconds. A lower bound is the smallest
time limit it allows, before it is rounded up to `timeResolution`; an upper bound is
the largest time limit it allows.
value.title: Value

solution.description:
The solution that set this bound, when it came from a measured
solution of the group. Absent when the bound was derived from another group's limit.
solution.title: Solution

lowerBound.description:
The lower bound this group's time limit had to respect, when it
was estimated from multipliers. Presentation-only.

upperBound.description:
The upper bound this group's time limit had to respect, when it
was estimated from multipliers and some slow solution of the group bounded it.
Presentation-only.

upperValidation.description:
What checking this group's slow solutions against its estimated
time limit found. Absent when the group has no slow solutions. Presentation-only.

estimatedTimeLimit.description:
The time limit `rbx time` estimated for this group, recorded
only when the setter has since changed `timeLimit` by hand with `rbx time --edit`.
The bounds and the upper validation of this report were measured against this
limit, not against `timeLimit`. Absent while the limit is the estimated one.
Presentation-only.
estimatedTimeLimit.title: Estimatedtimelimit

lowerViolation.description:
The smallest time limit this group's own accepted solutions
allow, recorded only when the group's time limit is below it -- that is, when the
limit was derived from a reference group or the base estimate instead of being
estimated from the group's own solutions, and the group's own solutions do not fit
in it. `solution` is the accepted solution that sets the bound. Absent whenever the
limit respects the group's own evidence. Presentation-only.

droppedUpper.title: Droppedupper

TimingGroupUpperValidation.description: What checking a group's slow solutions against its time limit found.

confirmed.description:
Solutions of this group expected to be too slow that were
confirmed to be so: they were still running once the estimated time limit times
`timeLimitToTle` had elapsed. Presentation-only.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

violating.description:
Solutions of this group expected to be too slow that finished
within the estimated time limit times `timeLimitToTle`, so they do not respect the
upper bound. `value` is the time the solution actually took. Presentation-only.
violating.title: Violating

skipped.description:
Solutions of this group expected to be too slow that were not
run, either because `timeLimitToTle` is unset or because the validation phase was
skipped. Presentation-only.
skipped.title: Skipped

TimingGroupUpperValidation.title: TimingGroupUpperValidation

acToTimeLimit.description:
Minimum ratio between the time limit and the slowest accepted
solution, used to estimate the time limit from below: the slowest accepted solution
times `acToTimeLimit` must fit within the time limit.
acToTimeLimit.title: Actotimelimit

fastestToTimeLimit.description:
Minimum ratio between the time limit and the fastest accepted
solution, an additional lower bound on top of `acToTimeLimit`: the fastest accepted
solution times `fastestToTimeLimit` must also fit within the time limit. When set,
the estimate is no longer the Kattis rule (which only scales the slowest accepted
solution), so a judge that estimates by that rule cannot reproduce it.
fastestToTimeLimit.title: Fastesttotimelimit

timeLimitToTle.description:
Minimum ratio between the fastest solution expected to be too
slow and the time limit: the time limit times `timeLimitToTle` must fit within the
fastest solution expected to be too slow. When omitted, solutions expected to be too
slow are not run and the time limit is not bounded from above.
timeLimitToTle.title: Timelimittotle

inferenceTimeout.description:
Deprecated: use `timing.inferenceTimeout`, which applies to
every estimation strategy instead of only to multiplier-based ones. Kept for
backwards compatibility; setting both is an error.
inferenceTimeout.title: Inferencetimeout

timeResolution.description:
Granularity (in milliseconds) of the estimated time limit.
The estimate is the smallest multiple of this value that is valid.
timeResolution.title: Timeresolution

inheritFromPackage.description: Whether to inherit limits from the package.
inheritFromPackage.title: Inheritfrompackage

timeLimit.description: Time limit of the problem, in milliseconds.
timeLimit.title: Timelimit

memoryLimit.description: Memory limit of the problem, in MB.
memoryLimit.title: Memorylimit

outputLimit.description: Output limit of the problem, in KB.
outputLimit.title: Outputlimit

modifiers.description: Limit modifiers that can be specified per language.
modifiers.title: Modifiers

formula.description: A formula to estimate the time limit for the problem.
formula.title: Formula

multipliers.description:
The multipliers this profile was estimated from, when it was estimated from
ratios instead of a formula. Presentation-only; never used for limit resolution.

groups.description:
Metadata describing the language grouping used when this profile was estimated.
Presentation-only; never used for limit resolution.
groups.title: Groups

baseEstimate.description:
Metadata describing how the base (fallback) time limit was estimated, pooled
across every solution. Presentation-only; never used for limit resolution.

estimationChecksum.description:
A checksum of everything this estimate was computed from -- the solutions that
bound the limit, and, when the tests were built, the interactor and the test
inputs. Written by `rbx time`; consumers compare it against the package to warn
that a saved limit predates the current solutions or testset.

Presentation-only; never used for limit resolution. Absent on a profile whose
limit was not estimated (inherited from the package, or set by hand).
estimationChecksum.title: Estimationchecksum

solutions.description:
The timing of every solution the estimate was computed from. Written by
`rbx time` and read by `rbx time --edit`, which checks a hand-set limit against
each solution. Presentation-only; never used for limit resolution. Absent on a
profile estimated before it was recorded.
solutions.title: Solutions
